name: cx-sequence~p1
task: First find the key and then pick it up. After that, open the locked door, enter the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(has_matching_key) clause is redundant – the task already forces picking up the key via the precedence chain (key_found → has_matching_key → target_door_open → target_room_entered → target_picked_up) that ends with the final hard goal Existence(target_picked_up). An Existence on an intermediate step of a hard Precedence chain repeats what the chain already guarantees (checklist item 6). Remove the Existence(has_matching_key) clause; keep the Precedence(key_found, has_matching_key) and the rest of the chain together with the final Existence(target_picked_up).

texts: The key must be found before the agent picks it up.
The agent must open the locked door after picking up the key.
The agent must enter the target room after the locked door is opened.
The agent must pick up the target ball after entering the target room.
The agent must eventually pick up the target ball.
